headline: The Tombstone Story
intro: Three generations. Tombstone, Arizona to Roswell, New Mexico.
story:
The Tombstone Gunsmith goes back to around 1956, when Judge Harold Fish ran a small gunsmith shop and gun store at 402 Allen Street in Tombstone, Arizona. Harold later worked out of 1212 Toughnut Street and served the town as its magistrate. His sons James and Bill never smithed for a living, but both were gun men their whole lives.

Anthony Fish got a Stevens single shot .22 the year he was born and a Ruger Bearcat in 1977. He spent his childhood summers in Tombstone learning to reload and chasing jackrabbits.

In 2022 his wife gave him a Colt Competition Series 1911 in .38 Super. It would not run. A friend sent him to Ray Melendez of Alien Arms, then in Dexter, New Mexico, who deburred, polished and tuned it and swapped in better parts until it ran and shot true. Anthony went on to apprentice under Ray. His family started calling him Gen 3 and handed him the Tombstone Gunsmith name.

In 2023 he reestablished The Tombstone Gunsmith, LLC in Roswell, New Mexico. Today the shop fine tunes the guns you already own and builds custom 1911 and double stack 1911 pistols. It runs on faith, family and the same name Harold painted on his truck.
